*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .tura/script/http-api-test.mjs
+import { spawn, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
+import { mkdirSync, openSync, closeSync } from 'node:fs'
+
+const port = 3101
+const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`
+mkdirSync('.tura/logs', { recursive: true })
+const out = openSync('.tura/logs/http-api-dev.out.log', 'w')
+const err = openSync('.tura/logs/http-api-dev.err.log', 'w')
+const child = spawn(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm', ['run', 'dev', '--', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(port)], {
+  stdio: ['ignore', out, err],
+  shell: false,
+})
+
+function stop() {
+  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid) {
+    if (process.platform === 'win32') spawnSync('taskkill', ['/pid', String(child.pid), '/t', '/f'], { stdio: 'ignore' })
+    else child.kill('SIGTERM')
+  }
+  closeSync(out)
+  closeSync(err)
+}
+
+async function waitForServer() {
+  const deadline = Date.now() + 60_000
+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`dev server exited early with ${child.exitCode}`)
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/catalog`)
+      if (response.ok) return
+    } catch {}
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600))
+  }
+  throw new Error('dev server did not become ready')
+}
+
+try {
+  await waitForServer()
+  const catalog = await fetch(`${base}/api/catalog?model=GPT-4o`).then((response) => response.json())
+  if (!Array.isArray(catalog.prompts) || catalog.prompts.length < 4) throw new Error('catalog API did not return GPT-4o prompts')
+  const cart = await fetch(`${base}/api/cart`).then((response) => response.json())
+  if (cart.subtotalCents !== 2100 || cart.totalCents !== 2268) throw new Error('cart API totals are wrong')
+  const analytics = await fetch(`${base}/api/analytics`).then((response) => response.json())
+  if (analytics.grossRevenueCents !== 10200 || analytics.dailySales.length !== 4) throw new Error('analytics API summary is wrong')
+  console.log('http api smoke passed')
+} finally {
+  stop()
+}
*** End Patch
